verdict.rationale: The evidence shows LocalAI can load and run a model from the command line (`local-ai run huggingface://...`, `local-ai run ollama://...`). Nothing documents CLI flags or options for GPU layer offload or context length. Automatic GPU backend detection is a different capability and does not let the user customize offload, and the --preload-models parameter is not shown to cover these settings.

support.subject: As a developer, I can load a model with custom GPU offload and context length settings from the command line
